# Country scope. Monarchy or empire-rank realm eligible for pretender/claimant intrigue.
oe_dip2_is_monarchy_or_empire = {
	OR = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
	}
}

# Country scope. Succession opening for contesting a monarchy's dynastic precedence.
oe_dip2_has_succession_opening = {
	OR = {
		has_heir = no
		legitimacy < 60
		AND = {
			has_ruler = yes
			ruler ?= { age_in_years >= 55 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Cross-worker soft-contract helper (W4 Little Ice Age relief discount).
oe_dip2_has_active_granary_cabinet = {
	has_variable = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag
}

# Country scope. Cross-worker soft-contract helper (W4 Silver Price Revolution reform discount).
oe_dip2_has_active_coinage_cabinet = {
	has_variable = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag
}

# Character scope. Eligible high-skill foreign master or general for covert poaching.
oe_dip2_eligible_poach_character = {
	is_alive = yes
	is_adult = yes
	is_ruler = no
	is_heir = no
	is_consort = no
	is_regent = no
	in_cabinet = no
	is_expedition_leader = no
	has_exploration = no
	modifier:blocked_from_character_interactions = no
	NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
	NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_dip2_royal_hostage_char }
	OR = {
		adm >= 70
		dip >= 70
		mil >= 70
	}
}

# Character scope. Eligible foreign royal/dynastic kinsman for hostage surety exchange.
oe_dip2_eligible_hostage_character = {
	is_alive = yes
	is_ruler = no
	is_regent = no
	in_cabinet = no
	is_expedition_leader = no
	has_exploration = no
	modifier:blocked_from_character_interactions = no
	NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
	NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_dip2_royal_hostage_char }
	OR = {
		has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
		has_dynasty = yes
	}
}

# Character scope. Living royal hostage currently residing at our court.
oe_dip2_is_hostage_character = {
	is_alive = yes
	has_variable = oe_dip2_hostage_home
	is_expedition_leader = no
	has_exploration = no
	modifier:blocked_from_character_interactions = no
	NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
}
